32: function parseYamlBlock(block: string): Frontmatter {
33:   const data: Frontmatter = {};
34:   let activeList: string | undefined;
35:   for (const line of block.split(/\r?\n/)) {
36:     if (!line.trim() || line.trimStart().startsWith('#')) continue;
